title: Remove the manager-based prototype and share the control arithmetic with the Direct task
summary: The manager-based prototype added more code than it would remove: the MuJoCo surrogate, AMP and the destination task still need TrainingTask and OmniVecEnv, and native parity keeps the raw PhysX reads. This change removes it; branch jcc463/manager-based-prototype keeps it at 0c071dc5. The Direct environment (omniwalk/env.py) now imports the termination rule, the 400 Hz load counters, the control telemetry, the toe points and the measured-state arithmetic from omniwalk/mdp/terminations.py, loads.py and state.py, as the surrogate does, and drops its own copies. The training metrics read the same termination constants. A stubbed Direct control that covers a fall, a tilt, a joint-limit violation and a timeout gives 191 bit-identical output tensors before and after the change.
next: Run the native parity harness on this source in the certification run that renews the c48_long receipt for the reformatted runtime.
reason: The arithmetic is unchanged and no gate or recorded result changes. The physics closure now includes the three shared modules; the pending certification of main's reformatted runtime covers this source as well.
